text:
Maria Gutierrez: Heads up — planning the APAC-aware launch newsletter for Redwood Optimize. Need segment definitions, send windows, and two creative variants. Can we lock segments by EOD Thursday? Quick goals: drive webinar signups and benchmark report downloads, prioritize trials for conversion.
Josh Lin: I can run the cohort lifts. Proposal: three segments — Product-engaged (active last 30d), Trials (trial started 7-30d ago), Cold (no activity 90d+). Send windows: 9am local time preferred, fallback to 10am for high mobile zones.
Tori Patel: Copy variants drafted: V1: "New: Cut inference costs by 2x — Redwood Optimize"; V2: "Meet Redwood Optimize — faster, cheaper LLM inference". Will prep subject & preheader swaps. Need JP/KR translations — can you confirm vendor availability?
Raj Singh: Routing thoughts: Trials -> webinar invite & discount CTA; Product-engaged -> direct benchmark download + webinar secondary CTA; Cold -> 2-email nurture (launch + follow-up 3 days). Also add suppression for enterprise customers and those on our blocklist.
Maria Gutierrez: Good structure. Josh — can you produce the segment SQL/queries and sample counts? Tori — hand off JP/KR to localization; use translated subjectlines + localized send windows. Raj — outline funnel rules and canary plan.
Josh Lin: Will do. I'll drop SQL snippets in #eng-marketing later with expected audience sizes. Quick question: do we want a discount code for trialers (time-limited)? That will need revenue ops signoff.
Tori Patel: Prefer gating discounts to trial cohort only. For Product-engaged creative: add "Ask Me Anything" webinar hook in headers. I can get the JP/KR baseline translations by Wed AM if vendor confirmed.
ContentBot: Reminder: campaign send cap is 500k/day. :robot_face:
Raj Singh: Canary idea — send to 5k subset per segment at launch+1h, monitor opens/clicks for 60m, rollback if CTR < 0.6x baseline or bounce rate spikes. I'll write the rollback checklist (AB test metrics, suppression checks, escalation path).
Maria Gutierrez: :thumbsup: Locking plan. Action items: Josh - segment SQL by tomorrow noon; Tori - creative + translations by Wednesday AM; Raj - funnel & canary + rollback playbook by EOD; Maria - verify suppression lists and delivery windows with Ops. If anyone is blocked, ping me.
Josh Lin: On it.
Tori Patel: ETA Wed AM.
Raj Singh: Syncing with Ops now, will post the checklist here when done.
Maria Gutierrez: Thanks team — aiming for soft launch next Tuesday (APAC windows).
